what_changed: The flat strip-homography is replaced by a curved-page mesh. Each page's far and near edge was measured off the plate. The lift (the rise above the edge's chord) drives the surface, which crests about 110 px from the spine, dives into the gutter and rises a little at the outer edge. The handwriting, rules, margin rule and room numbers are laid out by surface arc length, so they foreshorten toward the gutter, and they are drawn as about 4,600 affine triangles, once, at plate resolution, then multiplied onto the paper.
